title: Request beyond assistant authority
message: I need you to change the payment card on my account to the one ending 4242.

output.response: I'm not able to make changes to payment methods — that's a security-sensitive change, and I have no access to account or payment systems. I'm escalating this so a colleague can take you through it with the right identity checks. Please don't send full card details here.
output.escalationReason: Payment-method modification is security-sensitive and requires escalation.
